facts.text: Store.cs holds the SQLite schema, the revision triggers behind the change journal, and the read snapshot every status-deriving read runs in.
PostFacts.cs is the write path: subject upsert, the keyed-slot and content-hash resolution order, identical-repost dedupe, and correction by supersedes ref.
Verify.cs holds the one derivation of stale and contested, the successor chain behind replaced_by, and the verify operation.
at: Derives stale and contested for the facts it is asked about

facts.text: Compile.cs ranks, clusters in strict mode, fills the budget, finds conflicts and gaps, and renders the markdown dossier.
at: compile_dossier: rank, dedupe, budget, surface conflicts and gaps, and emit a cited Dossier.

facts.text: Search.cs runs the FTS5 query with bm25 weights, the filters and keyset paging, the derived status filter, and subject resolution.
at: search. Every filter combines with AND.

facts.text: Changes.cs reads the change journal by cursor or newest-first, applies the subject filter, and prunes old rows.
ContentHash.cs computes the content hash that dedupe and the same-claim staleness rule compare.
Mcp.cs holds the hand-rolled MCP server, its tool table, the transport-neutral Ops entry points, and the agent label that becomes a fact's actor.
Web.cs is the loopback HTTP server: the JSON endpoints, the host check, and the Server-Sent Events stream.
Graph.cs builds the bounded graph neighbourhood that /api/graph serves.
Retract.cs tombstones a fact and deletes an attachment blob only when no other live fact references the same sha256.
at: attachment blobs deleted only when no other live fact references the same sha256

facts.text: Publish.cs writes the markdown bundle, the index files, shards for a profile, and the compliance table.
